# Reelmaker
Always call tools as venv/bin/python and venv/bin/pip. Never use system python or pip.
Free-stack tool: user uploads one product photo + product details, gets a realistic 9:16 ad video.
Pipeline: input validation → LLM ad brief → TTS voiceover → image prep → background/scene → motion → captions → render.
**Core rule:** the real product photo is never regenerated by AI. AI/FFmpeg only build the background, motion, voice and text around it.

## Stack
Python 3.11, FFmpeg, FastAPI, SQLite, Piper TTS, faster-whisper, rembg, Pexels API, Gemini/Groq (free LLMs). All vendor calls go through provider adapters, swappable via `config.yaml`.

## Folder structure
```
app/            application code (future)
pipeline/providers/{llm,tts,visuals,render}/  one adapter per stage: synthesize(), generate(), etc.
jobs/           per-job working files (gitignored)
assets/         fonts, backgrounds, music (gitignored content)
docs/           PLAN_SOURCE.md, PLAN.md, STATE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, phases/, ISSUES.md, DECISIONS.md, TESTSET.md
```

## Session protocol
- At session start read only CLAUDE.md and docs/STATE.md. Then read only the one phase file for the current sub-phase. Never read PLAN_SOURCE.md or other phase files unless asked.
- Work on ONE sub-phase at a time. Do not start the next until the user confirms the pass check.
- Before coding, state the plan in at most 5 lines and wait for "go".
- After a pass is confirmed: tick PLAN.md, overwrite STATE.md, append to ISSUES.md/DECISIONS.md if anything happened, then give a git commit message and tag (v0a, v1c, ...).

## Token rules
- Make surgical, minimal, backward-compatible edits. No rewrites or refactors unless asked.
- Do not re-read a file already read this session. Use grep or line ranges for large files.
- Hardcoded paths/values are fine for a sub-phase's first run; generalize only in a later sub-phase.
- Keep command output small: `pytest -q`, `ffmpeg -loglevel error`, `pip -q`, head/tail on logs.
- No long explanations. Report: what changed, how to run it, what to check. Max 10 lines.
- Never paste full file contents back after editing.
- If a task needs a big install, a paid API, or more than 3 files changed, ask first.
- One provider adapter per stage: `synthesize()`, `generate()`, etc. Never call a vendor library outside `pipeline/providers/`.
- Never silently delete, rename, overwrite, or move existing files. Inspect before modifying.
